recognize_zh: 中央有一個淡染的淋巴濾泡，內含核較大、染色質開放的細胞與粉紅色間質，外圍環繞一圈深染的小淋巴球（mantle zone），左側有厚壁粉紅色血管，呈現正常次級濾泡的分層結構。
features: Nodule with a pale center of medium-to-large cells with vesicular nuclei and eosinophilic stroma/dendritic cell cytoplasm
Surrounding rim of densely packed small dark lymphocytes (mantle zone)
Outer zone of slightly paler small-to-medium lymphocytes
Thick-walled eosinophilic vessels at the left edge
describe_en: Section of lymphoid tissue at medium power shows a follicle with a pale center composed of medium-to-large cells with vesicular nuclei and eosinophilic stroma, surrounded by a rim of dense small lymphocytes and an outer paler zone. Thick-walled vessels are present at the left edge. The layered arrangement is preserved and there is no cytologic atypia. In the context of this series, findings are consistent with a normal secondary follicle, likely splenic white pulp.

ddx.vs: Hyaline-vascular Castleman shows regressed germinal centers penetrated by hyalinized radial vessels with onion-skin mantles, whereas this center is cellular without a penetrating lollipop vessel.
Neoplastic follicles lack a well-defined mantle and polarization and are BCL2 positive, while this follicle has a distinct mantle rim.
SMZL shows markedly expanded marginal zones around residual or colonized follicles, not the thin normal outer zone seen here.
